propositions: A new `surface-parity` overlay must be added to the four-pass code-review gate to detect when a write-operation parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (lib, CLI, or MCP) without corresponding updates to the sibling adapters.

The overlay fires when a diff touches a write-surface adapter file (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) via glob routing and must be wired into both round_a and round_b batches of the code-review.yaml workflow so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely an unused flag.

The overlay operates in advisory mode (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and must carry false-positive guards in the reviewer prompt to avoid flagging deliberately justified divergences (adapter-bound params like _creation_channel, internal-only refactors, or intentionally omitted capabilities).

The reviewer prompt must be packaged as a new file with deletion-impact/api-compat contract (category: code-review-pass, outputs: code_review_findings, execution_mode: agentic) and the base-reviewer catalog must list the overlay to keep the strict-enum drift test passing.
